description: On the desk in front are a computer mouse, a TV-style remote, a clear plastic piece, an open black case, a screwdriver, and a small adapter with a short white cable. The right hand reaches in from the right, grasps the mouse as a right-hand object, lifts it up and to the right, then lowers and releases it into the open black case while the left hand stays resting on the left side without touching anything.
